premise: Pelican scoops up a bottle instead of a snack; its cork pops, and the note inside is a drawing of a big white bird with a big orange beak: a pelican.
inspiration: The fisherman-finds-a-message folk motif turned comic and kind: the message from far away is a picture of the finder.
lesson: Someone, somewhere, may be thinking of you.

en-US.title: The Bottle and the Pelican
en-US.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pelican was standing at the water's edge, looking for a snack. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gull watched, perched up high. [curious] What will he catch? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Something green came bobbing in. {pelican:live} Scoop! went Pelican's big pouch. {seagull:face surprised} Out drained the water… and there in his beak was a bottle! [laughs] {seagull:live} Gull squawked with laughter. That's not a fish! {pelican:face surprised} Pelican tipped it this way and that. {bottle:live} {sfx:pop} POP! went the cork, and out peeked a rolled-up note. {pelican:pulse} Pelican opened it with his beak. It was a drawing… of a big white bird, with a big orange beak. [gasps] It's ME! said Pelican. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} Somebody far away drew a pelican! {seagull:hop x2} [playfully] Then you're famous! said Gull. And Pelican stood up tall, proud as can be. {pelican:hearts}

es-ES.title: La botella y el pelícano
es-ES.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pelícano estaba en la orilla, buscando algo de comer. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota lo miraba desde arriba. [curious] ¿Qué pescará? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Algo verde llegó flotando. {pelican:live} ¡Zas!, hizo el gran buche de Pelícano. {seagull:face surprised} Se escurrió el agua… ¡y en su pico había una botella! [laughs] {seagull:live} Gaviota graznó de la risa. ¡Eso no es un pez! {pelican:face surprised} Pelícano la giró de un lado a otro. {bottle:live} {sfx:pop} ¡POP!, hizo el corcho, y asomó una nota enrollada. {pelican:pulse} Pelícano la abrió con el pico. Era un dibujo… de un pájaro grande y blanco, con un gran pico naranja. [gasps] ¡Soy YO!, dijo Pelícano. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} ¡Alguien muy lejos ha dibujado un pelícano! {seagull:hop x2} [playfully] ¡Entonces eres famoso!, dijo Gaviota. Y Pelícano se puso muy derecho, orgullosísimo. {pelican:hearts}
